construction: 48000 real samples (3 s) built like speech with f0 160 Hz and seed 3, followed by 112000 zeros so the 10 s window is zero padded.

metadata.comparisonRule: Portable comparison uses the maximum absolute error over the full 998x80 grid, which must be <= 3e-3. Generator check mode compares a fresh Core ML run with the committed grid by maximum absolute error <= 1e-3, never byte equality, because Core ML float output differs between environments.
metadata.inputConstruction: The oracle loads only the caller-provided FBank.mlmodelc using MLModel(contentsOf:configuration:) with .cpuOnly and feeds it the deterministic 10 s Float32 window named by `construction` as audio [1,1,160000]. The expected grid is the graph's fbank_features [1,1,80,998] output transposed to frame-major [998,80] and stored as exact Float32 values. No portable implementation is used as the oracle.
